question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.

guide_solution: a. Pearl of the Indian Ocean, is one of the nicknames of Sri Lanka. Besides, Sri Lanka is the land of sulime beauty which located in the Indian Ocean. That’s why, Sri Lanka is known as ‘Pearl of the Indian Ocean’. b. Ayubowan means “May you have the gift of long life.” Everyone is welcomed to Sri Lanka with this traditional greeting. c. The total land of Sri Lanka is about 65,600 square kilometers. d. The four major ethnic groups are – Sinhalese, Sri Lankan Tamils, Indian Tamils and Sri Lankan Moors or Muslims. 17 e. The population of Sri Lanka is about 20 million. f. Sri Lanka is the world’s largest tea exporter. g. The nicknames reveal the richness and beauty of Sri Lanka. h. Sri Lanka is located in the Indian Ocean just off the south-eastern coast of India. i. Sri Lanka produces and supplies a variety of spices such as cinnamon, cardamom, pepper, cloves and nutmeg etc. j. ‘Island nation’ means the nation which stands in a place which is surrounded by water. k. Ayubowan means "May you have the gift of long life." It is with this traditional greeting that everyone is welcomed to Sri Lanka. l. Pearl of the Indian ocean is one of the nicknames of Sri Lanka. Besides Sri Lanka is located in the Indian ocean. That's why Sir Lanka is known as Pearl of the Indian ocean. m The total land area of Sri Lanka is about 65,600 square kms.

stimulus: Marconi was born in Italy in 1874. He was born in a well off family in the country. He was a very good student who was very creative. He dreamt of making wireless telegraph. The ever greatest scientist Albert Einstein was born in Germany in 1879. He was born in a very educated and rich family. He was a very calm boy who did not like friends. He started walking and talking very late. He was not a good student who always made bad results in the examinations. He had a great interest for philosophy. He had a very extraordinary talent in Mathematics. He started research in 1905. He got PhD degree. His great achievement “The Theory of Relativity’. He got Nobel Prize in 1921.
